Objective maintenance observations:
- TP-001 README explicitly says the repository is deprecated and superseded by https://github.com/fpganinja/taxi; all new features and fixes move there.
- TP-002, TP-004, TP-005, TP-006, and TP-007 have recent inspected commits and were not archived; this is not a claim of support level.
- TP-003 was not archived but its inspected repository tip predates the other current tips; this audit makes no stronger maintenance claim.
